selection_rule: Among positive-strength candidates with no feasible-floor, solver or privacy-cap violations and mean paired reconstruction and live RMSE prices at most 5%, maximize the smaller of (coverage-gap reduction / .20) and (worst-zone reconstruction-RMSE reduction / .10). Break ties by smaller reconstruction RMSE price, then full strength, then smaller target. Report whether both target reductions are reached. Do not start final primary inference by treating a failed selection target as passed.
feasibility_interpretation: Report unconditional opportunity/global feasibility and shortfall explicitly. Infeasibility caused by absent contributors during an outage is not a constraint violation and is not removed from outcomes. No 90%-of-all-epochs feasibility requirement is imposed on this arrival-clock outage experiment.
